Operating in a fintech environment focused on financial markets and wealth technology, you will combine hands-on technical expertise with leadership to drive an automation-first approach to quality across the organisation. Working closely with Engineering, Product, and development teams, you'll shape strategy, implement scalable testing practices, and make a lasting impact on how software is built and delivered across the business. Responsibilities Define and drive the quality engineering strategy across Infront; Increase automated testing coverage across products and platforms; Support teams in embedding testing into CI/CD pipelines and day-to-day development; Contribute hands-on to automation frameworks, tooling, and technical quality initiatives where needed; Lead and develop QA engineers and SDETs; Support hiring and growth of quality engineering capability; Establish standards and best practices for testing and quality engineering; Work closely with engineering and product leadership to improve delivery quality and release confidence; Drive practical improvements to quality processes, tooling, and engineering practices. Who you are Qualifications & Experience Strong background as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) or similar hands-on quality engineering role; Proven experience leading QA transformations from manual testing to scalable automated testing frameworks; Experience building and scaling automated testing frameworks; Experience leading QA or quality engineering teams; Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, including CI/CD and automated testing; Experience working across multiple teams and stakeholders; Strong communication and collaboration skills; Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience preferred.
